name: widgetctl
description: Set up iOS Simulator Home Screen widgets with the local widgetctl CLI and API.

interface.longDescription: Add, find, edit and remove individual iOS Simulator Home Screen widgets with the bundled widgetctl CLI. The plugin includes the executable, native worker and runtime dependencies; no separate CLI install is required. Requires macOS, Node 22.14+ and full Xcode. TypeScript and Playwright projects can install the widgetctl npm package separately. Supports verified arm64 iPhone simulator runtimes; physical devices, stacks and Lock Screen widgets are unsupported.
